title: Our Great God
lyrics_original: They raise their voices day and night
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Lord, we are weak and frail
Rise up, oh Lord, and he will flee
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Let every creature in the sea
Let all the moons and all the stars
Sing praises to the living God
Who rules them by His Word!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!

bible_verses.english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
“For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

devotional.prayer_english: Eternal God, my heart is filled with wonder when I consider Your unchanging love and glorious majesty. Thank You for revealing Yourself to me in grace and mercy, even though You are far greater than I can fully comprehend. Along with all of creation, I give You my praise today. You alone are worthy of all glory and honor. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Eternal God, my heart is filled with wonder when I consider Your unchanging love and glorious majesty. devotional.reflection_english: The majesty of our eternal, unchanging God is matched only by His tender heart of grace toward us. Though He sits enthroned in unmatched glory surrounded by heavenly praise, He chooses to make Himself known to us in boundless mercy and love. As we join our voices with the angels, we are invited to rest in His unfailing character and celebrate the greatness of who He is. Let your heart be lifted today as you offer Him the honor He alone deserves.
